build_pixel_shuffle_upsample: build a PixelShufflePack module with in_channels, out_channels, scale_factor, and upsample_kernel args
build_upsample_layer_from_cfg: build an upsample layer from a config dict with type, scale_factor, and layer args
register_nearest_upsample: register a nearest neighbor upsample layer via UPSAMPLE_LAYERS registry using nn.Upsample
register_bilinear_upsample: register a bilinear upsample layer via UPSAMPLE_LAYERS registry using nn.Upsample
forward_pixel_shuffle: run forward pass on PixelShufflePack to convolve input tensor then apply pixel shuffle upsampling
